verdict.rationale: Box's docs mention metadata 'cascade policies' that apply metadata templates across all items in a folder in one operation (box-docs-38), which is a form of bulk operation, but there is no documented batch API for bulk create/move/copy/delete across arbitrary large sets of items, no bulk endpoint for search/collaboration changes, and no independent evidence of bulk automation performance at scale. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk REST endpoints for common operations, rate-limit guidance for bulk automation, and hands-on confirmation that bulk workflows work reliably for AI agents.
